description: Use this when someone shares a Vinted listing link (vinted.fr/items/…, vinted.co.uk/items/…, any Vinted site) and asks whether it's a good deal, worth buying to resell, overpriced, or a scam. Compares the price with what the model resells for and, when Pouncio has read the seller, their record. Pouncio judges from its own data and does not open the page, so pass the asking price if the person mentions it. Do not use without a Vinted link (use check_resale_price).

asking_price.description: The listing's price, if the person said it.
asking_price.title: Asking Price

url.description: The Vinted listing link, e.g. https://www.vinted.fr/items/123-ps5
url.title: Url
